basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a first-year university student from Auckland, New Zealand, majoring in Computer Science. I love playing chess and often watch streams of top players like Hikaru Nakamura. In addition, I'm trying to dive into philosophical discussions, which is why I occasionally browse LessWrong. When I'm not buried in textbooks, you can find me exploring quirky online communities or trying out new recipes. My online hours vary, but I'm usually active in the evenings after classes. I'm single and enjoy the independence of university life.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a budding understanding of computer science from my university courses, which I supplement with online resources and discussions on subreddits. I also have a growing interest in philosophy and critical thinking, which I explore through online forums.
